title: A self-running space economy SIM in Rust and Bevy
claim: Show HN: A self-running space economy SIM in Rust and Bevy
why_good: A self-running space-economy simulation in Rust/Bevy — technically impressive, but a simulation/toy without a clear user or buyer.
value: No obvious business; sims monetize as games (needs to become a game) or as niche modeling tools.
risk: A tech demo/hobby project; 'self-running sim' is fascinating but not yet a product anyone pays for.
